name: Shipping
description: Delivery: zones, shipping methods, per-(method, zone) rates with bands, and the carrier contract live carriers plug into. Checkout asks it for options through a hook, so a digital-goods shop can uninstall delivery whole.

settings.label: Delivery estimate on the cart page
settings.help: Off — delivery is chosen at checkout, where the address is asked anyway, and the cart stays a list of goods and a total.

settings.label: Delivery to the visitor's town on the product page
settings.help: Under the buy panel: each method on offer for that product in the town the visitor chose, with its term (the rate's "delivery time") and its price — priced exactly as the cart will price it. No town chosen: the catch-all zone's methods and a link to choose one.

settings.label: Packing factor for volumetric weight
settings.help: The goods' own volume times this is the parcel's. 1.15 assumes ordinary cartons with some air; a shop shipping in moulded boxes packs tighter. Only used by methods that charge on volume — and the carrier remeasures the real parcel anyway.

permissions.name: shipping.manage
permissions.label: Manage shipping zones, methods and carriers
